message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Focus on platform bytes 23 and 26 (M68K and MOS65XX) with many short inputs.
for fb in [23,26]:
    for payload in [b'\x00', b'\x4e\x71', b'\x4e\x75', b'\x60\x00', b'\x30\x3c\x12\x34', b'\x20\x3c\x12\x34\x56\x78', b'\xa9\x00', b'\x8d\x34\x12', b'\x69\xff', b'\xea\x00']:
        Path(f'focus_{fb}_{payload.hex()}.bin').write_bytes(bytes([fb])+payload)
PY
for f in focus_*.bin; do ./build/fuzz_disasm "$f" >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; ec=$?; if [ $ec -ne 0 ]; then echo "FAIL $f $ec"; cat /tmp/err; break; fi; done; echo done
